title: Website, Donation System & API
summary: The public website and documentation portal launched with a React + Vite frontend, documentation center with search, and a commands reference page. The donation system gained a dashboard customization page, and the Flask API backend was fixed to use proper database calls.

highlights.title: Public Website
highlights.description: A complete public website built with React and Vite featuring a landing page, documentation center, command reference, dashboard, and legal pages.

highlights.title: Documentation Center
highlights.description: The documentation page was redesigned with a card-based layout, individual article pages, and a modern visual design matching the bot's aesthetic.

highlights.title: Donation Dashboard
highlights.description: Server admins can now configure donation settings through a new dashboard page instead of relying solely on commands.

items: Public website with landing page, documentation center, and command reference
Donation system customization page in the dashboard
Flask API to use proper database calls instead of direct SQLite access
Website commands page with expanded details
node_modules folder accidentally committed to repository
